about: TAB is a company in Commercial Real Estate that provides short-term bridging loans for property, with its location shown in Borehamwood, Hertfordshire, United Kingdom. Crunchbase shows about 920 million in funding, last event in September 2025. It cannot be confirmed from the input how large it is, who owns it or what products it offers beyond bridging finance. B2B property lender with no known consumer brand. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Binghatti is a Dubai property developer known for distinctive, design-led residential towers across Dubai, including projects branded with luxury partners such as Bugatti Residences, Jacob & Co and Mercedes-Benz Places. It sells apartments to local and international buyers and investors, and is a large builder of high-rise towers in the emirate. Founded by the Binghatti family and led by Muhammad Binghatti, it has raised debt in the form of sukuk bonds. Strongly branded, marketing-led developer in the UAE with visible billboards and sports and events sponsorship appetite.

dsm-firmenich is a Dutch-Swiss company, created in 2023 by the merger of DSM and Firmenich, producing flavours, fragrances, nutritional ingredients, vitamins and health and beauty ingredients. It sells to food and drink, perfume, personal care, pharma and animal feed makers worldwide, with annual revenue around EUR 12bn and about 28,000 staff. Its animal nutrition business is being divested. Listed on Euronext Amsterdam (DSFIR), with offices in Kaiseraugst and Maastricht. B2B ingredient supplier; consumers rarely see the brand, though customers include major consumer brands.

Valentino is a Milan-based Italian luxury fashion house, founded in 1960 in Rome by Valentino Garavani and Giancarlo Giammetti, selling ready-to-wear, accessories, shoes, beauty and fragrance through boutiques, department stores and e-commerce worldwide, with revenue near EUR 1.4bn. Qatar's Mayhoola owns it, and Kering agreed in 2023 to buy a 30 percent stake, rising to full ownership by 2028. Private. Globally recognised luxury brand, with the red Valentino colour as an asset; limited sports ties.

Tiendas 3B is a Mexican retail chain that, according to Crunchbase, offers household cleaning, personal hygiene, food and beverage and other everyday products. It is listed with a location in Colima, Mexico, and is classified under cosmetics and food and beverage. Crunchbase shows about $1.03 billion in funding, likely corporate or debt financing. Store count, ownership and revenue are not stated in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Specific brands and scale are not confirmed. The input shows its work in beauty and brand marketing, and it appears to own a portfolio of consumer products sold online. about: US beauty company founded in 1932 and based in New York, selling cosmetics, nail polish, hair colour and fragrance under Revlon, Almay, Elizabeth Arden and Elizabeth Taylor lines, mass-market through retailers worldwide. Filed for Chapter 11 in 2022 and emerged in 2023 as a private company owned by its lenders. Revenue is roughly USD 1.9 billion. Consumer brand sold in many countries with very high awareness.

wiki.title: Revlon
wiki.text: Revlon, Inc., is an American multinational company dealing in cosmetics, skin care, perfume, and personal care. The headquarters of Revlon was established in New York City on March 1, 1932, where it remains. Revlon was founded by brothers Charles and Joseph Revson, and chemist Charles Lachman. Revlon products are sold in 150 countries and the company has many global locations including Mexico City, London, Paris, Hong Kong, Indonesia, South Africa, Sydney, Singapore, and Tokyo.

about: Brazilian cosmetics and beauty group, owner of Natura, Avon, The Body Shop and Aesop. Direct-selling model with millions of consultants. Based in Sao Paulo, listed on B3 (NATU3). Now named Natura Cosmeticos, the group sold Aesop to L'Oreal in 2023 and The Body Shop to Aurelius that year. Avon Products went through a US Chapter 11 process in 2024. Strong global consumer brands.

MAV Beauty Brands is described in the input as a high-growth global personal care company based in Vaughan, Ontario, Canada, operating in beauty and cosmetics. It owns and sells a portfolio of beauty and personal care brands through retailers and online channels. Crunchbase shows about C$230 million of funding in November 2016, which suggests institutional backing. The input does not name the individual brands, revenue or owners. Consumer-product company whose corporate name is little known. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: JCPenney is a US mid-range department store chain selling apparel, home goods and jewellery from about 650 stores and online. Headquartered in Plano, Texas; founded 1902. It went bankrupt in 2020 and was bought out of Chapter 11 by Simon Property Group and Brookfield, then merged with SPARC Group (Aeropostale and Nine West owner) in early 2025 to form Catalyst Brands. Established household brand across the US, particularly in small and mid-size towns.

wiki.title: JCPenney
wiki.text: JCPenney is an American department store chain founded in 1902 by James Cash Penney. It is owned by Catalyst Brands, a joint venture between Authentic Brands Group, Brookfield Corporation, and Simon Property Group, since 2025.

about: Hudson's Bay Company was a Canadian retail group founded in 1670, and one of the oldest companies in North America. It operated Hudson's Bay department stores in Canada, and earlier owned Saks Fifth Avenue and Lord and Taylor, selling fashion, beauty and home goods. After pandemic pressures, the Canadian business sought creditor protection in March 2025 and liquidated, closing all stores by mid-2025. The Saks brands sit in separate Saks Global. Formerly a very recognisable Canadian consumer brand; now defunct as a retailer.

wiki.title: Hudson's Bay Company
wiki.text: The Hudson's Bay Company was a Canadian holding company of department stores and commercial property. It was the oldest commercial corporation in North America, founded in 1670 and liquidated in 2025. It was headquartered at the Simpson Tower in Toronto, becoming an intellectual property and brand of Canadian Tire for its iconic point stripe blankets and other merchandise within Canadian Tire stores.

about: Gildan is a Montreal-based manufacturer of basic apparel, selling T-shirts, fleece, socks, underwear and hosiery under brands such as Gildan, Gold Toe, Comfort Colors, American Apparel and Hanes after buying HanesBrands in a deal announced in 2025. It is vertically integrated, with plants in Central America and the Caribbean, selling mostly to screen printers and wholesale distributors, plus retailers. Revenue is around $3.3bn. Listed on the NYSE and TSX (GIL). Wholesale-focused, so the consumer brand profile is modest apart from its retail sock and underwear brands.

wiki.title: Gildan
wiki.text: Gildan Activewear Inc. is a Canadian manufacturer of branded clothing, including undecorated blank activewear such as t-shirts, hoodies and fleeces, which are subsequently decorated by screen printing companies with designs and logos. The company also supplies branded and private label athletic, casual, and dress socks to retail companies in the United States including Gold Toe Brands, PowerSox, SilverToe, Auro, All Pro, and the Gildan brand. The company also manufactures and distributes Under Armour and New Balance brand socks. The company has approximately 50,000 employees worldwide, and owns and operates manufacturing facilities in Rio Nan

about: Quince is a San Francisco direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand selling apparel (cashmere, silk, linen), homeware, leather goods, jewellery and bedding at lower prices by cutting out the middleman. Customers are mainly US online shoppers, with expansion into Europe. Founded in 2018, it raised $500m in 2025 at a $4.5bn valuation. Private. Growing consumer brand with heavy social-media advertising, and a growing sports and media sponsorship presence.

Cenomi Retail (formerly Fawaz Alhokair Group) is a Riyadh-based Saudi lifestyle retailer, operating and franchising international fashion, footwear, food and beauty brands such as Zara, H&M, Marks and Spencer, Mothercare and Bath and Body Works in Saudi Arabia, the UAE and across the Middle East. It is linked to Cenomi Centers, the mall owner, and Cenomi Group. Listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 4240). Household name for Saudi shoppers, with many consumer-facing stores.

Vuori is a Carlsbad, California premium activewear and athleisure brand, founded in 2015, selling performance joggers, shorts, tops and outerwear for men and women through its own stores, e-commerce and wholesale partners. Revenue is estimated near $1bn+, and it was valued at $5.5bn in a 2024 round led by Norwest and others, with additional investors. Private. Fast-growing lifestyle brand with strong social media following, particularly among men in the US.

Farfetch is a London-based online luxury fashion marketplace, founded in 2007 by Jose Neves, connecting boutiques and brands with consumers in about 190 countries and owning Browns, Stadium Goods and New Guards (Off-White). Coupang acquired it in a rescue deal in 2024 after it struggled and was delisted from the NYSE. Strong luxury consumer brand with sports and fashion collaborations.

wiki.title: Farfetch
wiki.text: Farfetch is a global luxury marketplace headquartered in London. It operates as a digital marketplace that sells products from over 1,400 brands, boutiques and department stores from around the world. In January 2024, the company was acquired by Coupang, a U.S. technology and Fortune 150 company, headquartered in Seattle, Washington.

about: Reformation is a US sustainable women's fashion brand, with its corporate base in Los Angeles (the input lists Vernon Hills, Illinois). It sells dresses, tops, denim and shoes through its own stores and online. Founded in 2009, it was acquired by Permira in 2023 and has dozens of stores. Strong consumer brand known for sustainability messaging and celebrity customers.

wiki.title: Reformation
wiki.text: The Reformation, also known as the Protestant Reformation or the European Reformation, was a major theological movement in Western Christianity in 16th-century Europe that posed a religious and political challenge to the papacy and the authority of the Catholic Church hierarchy. Towards the end of the Renaissance, the Reformation marked the beginning of Protestantism. It is considered one of the events that signified the end of the Middle Ages and the beginning of the early modern period in Europe.

about: NOBULL is a Boston-based fitness footwear and apparel brand, founded in 2015, best known for training shoes such as the Trainer and Ripstop Runner, tennis shoes, apparel and accessories for CrossFit and gym athletes. It sells online, through its own stores and retailers, and has sponsored the CrossFit Games. It has raised about $150 million. Strong consumer brand in the fitness community, with athlete endorsements and a cult following, and it has expanded into performance running and lifestyle product.

Mitra Adiperkasa is one of Indonesia's largest lifestyle and fashion retailers, operating and franchising international brands such as Zara, Marks & Spencer, Starbucks, Burger King, Pull&Bear, Massimo Dutti, Lego, Foot Locker and Sports Station through hundreds of stores across the country. Customers are mass and premium Indonesian consumers, and it earns retail and food-and-beverage revenue. Listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (MAPI), founded in 1995. Its stores are visible in malls across Indonesia, although it is a retail operator rather than a single consumer brand of its own.

North American beverage company formed in 2018, combining Keurig Green Mountain coffee brewers and K-Cups with Dr Pepper Snapple's soft drinks, including Dr Pepper, 7UP, Canada Dry, Snapple, A&W and Core, and the acquisition of GHOST energy drinks. Sells to consumers through retailers and foodservice, with revenue near 15 billion dollars. Headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts and Frisco, Texas. Listed on Nasdaq (KDP), with JAB Holding a major holder; it announced a 2025 plan to acquire JDE Peet's. Strong US consumer brands.

wiki.title: Keurig Dr Pepper
wiki.text: Keurig Dr Pepper, Inc. is an American drinks conglomerate with dual headquarters in Burlington, Massachusetts, and Frisco, Texas. The company was formed on July 9, 2018, through the merger of Keurig Green Mountain and Dr Pepper Snapple Group.

about: Canadian convenience store and fuel retailer operating Circle K, Couche-Tard and Ingo, with around 17,000 stores in 29 countries across North America, Europe and Asia. Sells fuel, fast food and everyday items to consumers, with revenue near 70 billion dollars. Headquartered in Laval, Quebec; founded 1980. Listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (ATD). It pursued a 2025 bid for Seven & i, which later was withdrawn. Circle K is a very recognisable consumer brand and a past motorsport sponsor.

wiki.title: Couche-Tard
wiki.text: Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc., or simply Couche-Tard, is a Canadian multinational operator of convenience stores. The company operates approximately 16,700 stores across Canada, the United States, Mexico, Ireland, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Japan, Hong Kong, and Indonesia. The company operates its corporate stores mainly under the Couche-Tard, Circle K, and On the Run brands but also under the affiliated brands Mac's Convenience Stores, GetGo, go!, Provi-Soir, 7-jours, Dairy/Daisy Mart, Becker's and Winks.

about: US food company known for Greek yogurt, also selling oat milk, creamers, coffee drinks, kefir and probiotics. Founded in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, with its largest facilities in New Berlin, New York and Twin Falls, Idaho, and revenue near 3 billion dollars plus. Sells through supermarkets across the US and abroad. Privately held, with TPG and others as investors; raised large capital in 2025 at a valuation of 20 billion dollars. Strong consumer brand and a sponsor of US Olympic and Paralympic teams.

wiki.title: Chobani
wiki.text: Chobani is an American food company specializing in strained yogurt. The company was founded in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya. Chobani sells thick, Greek yogurt with a higher protein content than traditional yogurt and is one of the main companies to popularize this style of yogurt in the US. The company has also expanded to non-dairy, plant-based products such as dairy-free vegan yogurt and oat milk. Chobani produces a variety of Greek yogurt products, oat drinks, and snacks. about: Grupo Nutresa is a Colombian processed food group making cold cuts, chocolates, biscuits, coffee, ice cream (Helados Crem Helado) and pasta, with brands such as Colcafe, Noel, Zenu and Jet. Customers are consumers across Latin America, with revenue near 3 billion dollars. Headquartered in Medellin. Controlled since 2025 by the Gilinski family's Nugil, which took control from Grupo Sura and Argos in a takeover. Trades on the Colombian Stock Exchange (NUTRESA). Strong Colombian consumer brands.

wiki.title: Grupo Nutresa
wiki.text: Grupo Nutresa S.A. (in English: Nutresa Group), formerly Grupo Nacional de Chocolates S.A. (in English: Chocolate National Group S.A.), is a Colombian multinational food processing conglomerate headquartered in Medellín. The group's principal activities are producing, distributing, and selling cold cuts, biscuits, chocolates, coffee, ice cream and pasta. The company markets its products under approximately 70 different brands in 65 countries. Other activities include the investment or application of resources or cash under whatever form authorized by law and the exploration of the metal-mechanic and packaging industry. about: Haldiram's Snacks is the Noida, Uttar Pradesh-based Indian snack food company behind Haldiram's bhujia, namkeen, sweets, ready-to-eat meals and packaged foods, sold through retail in India and exported to dozens of countries. It is a family-founded group with Bikaner, Nagpur and Delhi entities. In 2025 Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Alpha Wave and Temasek bought minority stakes valuing it at around $10bn. Private. Beloved Indian consumer brand with big advertising reach.

wiki.title: Haldiram's
wiki.what: Vegetarian Indian restaurant and foodstuff manufacturer
wiki.text: Haldiram's India Pvt Ltd, doing business as Haldiram's is an Indian multinational fast-food restaurant chain, founded in 1937, as a confectionery and desserts shop in Bikaner, Rajasthan, by Ganga Bhishen Agarwal. It is currently based in Nagpur, Maharashtra. Haldiram's is also a FMCG company as most of its restaurants have a integrated retail section, where packaged Indian snacks and confectioneries are sold under its own brand.

about: Hershey is a Pennsylvania-based confectionery and snack company founded in 1894, making Hershey's chocolate, Reese's, Kisses, Kit Kat (US license), Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, plus salty snacks such as SkinnyPop and Dot's Pretzels. Customers are consumers via grocery, mass retailers and convenience stores, mainly in North America, with sales of about $11 billion. Listed on NYSE (HSY), controlled by the Hershey Trust. Household-name consumer brand with heavy marketing.
